subtitle: An 18-kilometer dune beach in the Camargue where a lighthouse built 150 meters from the sea in 1869 now stands roughly 700 meters inland.
spike_statement: Built 150 meters from the sea in 1869, the Espiguette lighthouse now stands roughly 700 meters inland, stranded by sand its own coast keeps depositing.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gold late light over open dune and marram grass, a square white tower standing alone in sand far back from a low blue-green sea
